recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-13875; future UCUM wording changes should be made in the HL7 Terminology source for the UCUM page.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 Vocabulary issue requesting FHIR guidance on whether UCUM curly-brace expressions such as {beats}/min should be used in Quantity.code, with a resolution to add text explaining that UCUM is inherently compositional to the Using UCUM with FHIR page.
initial_application: Git commit e372de1ae6332c01a197b2428d7e0d1a0d55311d, matching Jira's svn revision 13080 comment, added a UCUM Expressions section to source/ucum.html describing UCUM compositional syntax, server support documentation in TerminologyCapabilities, and the common UCUM code value set fallback.
additional_context: Later Published issue FHIR-35933 and implemented proposal UP-289 moved the external code system usage pages from FHIR core to HL7 Terminology. Commit 81e5862f203fdb8a03e9c943a7cf455aba8973f4 deleted source/ucum.html and changed source/terminologies-systems.html to link UCUM to https://terminology.hl7.org/UCUM.html. The current THO language page at https://terminology.hl7.org/en/UCUM.html retains the UCUM Expressions guidance and discourages curly braces in code elements because they add descriptive text without changing code meaning.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current FHIR core has an active Code Systems page in source/hierarchy.xml that links to the THO UCUM guidance, and the local UCUM page was intentionally removed from the core build. Reintroducing UCUM prose in core would duplicate and potentially diverge from the authoritative THO page.

related_jiras.note: Published FHIR-core migration issue that removed external code system usage pages, including UCUM, from core and linked them to THO.
Implemented the THO side of the migration by adding the external code system usage pages as THO permalinks.
